title: Mock exam in the style of ZIMSEC O-Level Business Enterprise and Skills Paper 1
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on ZIMSEC O-Level Business Enterprise and Skills Paper 1: six compulsory structured questions on short scenarios, 1 hour 45 minutes, 100 marks. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer **all** six questions. You have 1 hour 45 minutes.

- The questions are worth 16 or 17 marks. Show your working in calculations.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The format follows Paper 1 as described in the 2015-2022 syllabus; the marks of each question are our convention. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.

title: Mock exam in the style of ZIMSEC O-Level Business Enterprise and Skills Paper 2
description: A full-length practice paper modelled on ZIMSEC O-Level Business Enterprise and Skills Paper 2: one compulsory case study (Section A, 40 marks) and three essays chosen from six (Section B, 60 marks), 2 hours 15 minutes, 100 marks. This is an original practice paper written for this platform in the style of the real examination. It is not an official paper, and its questions are not past-paper questions.
instructions:
Answer the case study in Section A and **three** questions from Section B. You have 2 hours 15 minutes.

- Read the case study carefully and use its data in your answers.
- Section B essays are worth 20 marks each; if you answer more than three, your best three count.
- Written answers cannot be marked automatically: after you submit, each one is shown with our mark scheme so that you can mark your own answer honestly. Multiple-choice, numerical and short factual answers are marked automatically.

The format follows Paper 2 as described in the 2015-2022 syllabus. Check the instructions on your own examination papers.
